item.title: Kelley Clayton Was Killed by a Man Her Husband Hired
item.description: Kelley Clayton was murdered in her New York home in September 2015 while her children were inside. Investigators uncovered a plot involving her husband, Thomas, and his former employee, Michael Beard. Both men were convicted of murder and sentenced to life without parole.

item.title: Dorothy Jane Scott Vanished but the Calls Continued
item.description: Dorothy Jane Scott received threatening calls before disappearing from a California hospital parking lot in May 1980. Afterward, an unidentified man repeatedly called her parents, claiming responsibility. Her remains were discovered in 1984, but the caller’s identity and the circumstances of her death remained unresolved.

item.title: Prosecutors Say d4vd Killed Celeste to Silence Her
item.description: Prosecutors allege that d4vd killed 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez after she threatened to expose his alleged sexual abuse. Their court filing outlines messages, a rideshare trip to his home, and alleged efforts to conceal her death. He pleaded not guilty, and his lawyers deny he caused her death.

item.title: Bill Rundle Went From Father of the Year to Murderer
item.description: Once named a Las Vegas Father of the Year, Bill Rundle was convicted of murdering his wife, Shirley, and his mother, Willa. His 2003 pleas ended his trial, but left questions about his mother’s disappearance unanswered. He received two life sentences without parole.

item.title: It Took 50 Years to Prove That Ted Bundy Did This
item.description: More than five decades after Laura Ann Aime was killed in Utah, advanced DNA testing confirmed Ted Bundy’s involvement. Preserved evidence allowed investigators to establish the forensic link that had been missing for years and officially close her 1974 murder case.
